categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P label and modifies connection management and peer discouragement handling in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Discouraging private broadcast peers breaks the privacy guarantees of private broadcast by leaking node identity across P2P interfaces. As noted in review, marking misbehaving private broadcast peers as discouraged can be observed externally or cause operator-configured connections to drop if another peer on the subnet misbehaves.
